## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contract-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Boundary checklist

- [ ] I preserved stable wire identifiers or documented a deliberate versioned migration.
- [ ] Fixture, replay, and live-data status remain explicit.
- [ ] No credential, raw licensed body, broker action, or executable trading path was introduced.
- [ ] The viewer remains a completed-result projection without research business logic.
- [ ] Tests, documentation, and changelog entries were updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff for unrelated or generated changes.
